title: Strict representative normalization of the completed pullback comparison
statement: Fix an adic coefficient datum d and an arbitrary scheme morphism h:U→T [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Let K be a K-flat cochain complex of actual completed-coefficient module sheaves on T, let K0 be any derived object and e:K0→Q(K), and let r map the pulled strict reduction tower of K [def-weil-pbc-reduction-augmentation] to a K-injective strict tower I. Form the strict augmentation a from the constant tower of ordinary module pullback of K by the constant/pullback complex equality followed by degreewise tower pullback of the module reduction unit. Then completedPullbackComparison at K0, followed by Rlim of the pulled reduction-tower map of e, the reduction and tower-pullback computation counits and Q(r), and the universal right-derived computation isomorphism on I [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality], equals ordinary derived pullback of e, its complex computation counit on K, and Q of the constant/limit adjunct of a followed by r. No quasi-isomorphism condition on r and no Roos map are required.

source.place: Tag 0941, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok, proof; proetale.tex Tag 099N(5). Strict-unit and universal-derived-counit computation in steps 1–2 of lem-weil-pbc-integral-actual-unit-roos-normalization.

proof.text: On K, the specified normalization of the reduction unit identifies its composite with the universal counit with the localized module quotient unit. The quotient comparison isomorphisms on complexes are identity components, so the raw homotopy counit agrees with the stated complex counit.

Use naturality of completedReductionPullbackComplexNat on the module quotient unit, and the specified K-flat normalization of completedPullbackConstantIso. Functoriality and associativity identify the tower comparison with the localized strict augmentation preceded by the ordinary computation counit. Transport along e by naturality of the constant/pullback comparison and reduction unit.

Expand completedPullbackComparison and use naturality of the constant/Rlim unit. Its representative formula cancels the inverse and forward constant-tower localization factors. Apply rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ_naturality to the whole strict augmentation followed by r and rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ_eq on K-injective I. The remaining chain map is exactly its constant/limit adjunct. This uses no quasi-isomorphism hypothesis on r and works for zero complexes and empty schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem completedPullbackComparison_strict_normalization
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    {U T : Scheme.{u}} (h : U ⟶ T)
    (K : CochainComplex (pbcModules T (pbcAdicCompletion T d)) ℤ)
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (R := pbcAdicCompletion T d) K)
    (K₀ : DerivedCategory (pbcModules T (pbcAdicCompletion T d))) (e : K₀ ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
    (I : CochainComplex (pbcTowers U (pbcAdicCompletion U d)) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective]
    (r : ((completedTowerModulePullback h d).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      ((completedReductionComplexTowerFunctor T d).obj K) ⟶ I) :
    letI := completedReductionModuleTowerFunctor_additive T d
    completedPullbackComparison h d K₀ ≫
        (completedTowerRlim d U).map
          ((completedTowerPullback h d).map
              ((completedReductionTower T d).map e ≫
                completedReductionTowerComplexCounit T d K) ≫
            completedTowerPullbackComplexCounit h d
              ((completedReductionComplexTowerFunctor T d).obj K) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map r) ≫
        (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso
          (lim : pbcTowers U (pbcAdicCompletion U d) ⥤
            pbcModules U (pbcAdicCompletion U d)) I).hom =
      (completedOrdinaryPullback h d).map e ≫
        completedOrdinaryPullbackComplexCounit h d K ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (((constLimAdj : completedTowerConstant d U ⊣ lim).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).homEquiv _ I ((eqToHom (completedPullbackConstantComplex_eq h d K) ≫
              ((completedTowerModulePullback h d).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
                ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (completedReductionModuleUnit d T)
                  (.up ℤ)).app K)) ≫ r))
